geopolitics.headline: Democrat Scott Colom seals historic win in Mississippi Senate race
geopolitics.summary: Colom is the first black person from the southern state elected to the US Senate in over 140 years.

geopolitics.headline: Israeli strike on Nasser Hospital kills at least six, Gaza civil defence agency says

geopolitics.headline: Clashes erupt in Barcelona after thousands join Spain general strike
geopolitics.summary: Tens of thousands of people have been taking part in the strike, called by the country's main unions over housing and the high cost of living.
